front_wall_skin.derivation: At rearZ40.6, R4 corner centre(80.75,4.25), nearest channel corner(81.1,1.7); thickness4-sqrt(0.35^2+2.55^2). Dividing by sqrt(1+2*(0.25/40.6)^2) conservatively accounts for loft slope. This is channel skin, not a blanket minimum over all designed holes or cosmetic rims.

usb_load_path.description: Insertion+Y: connector board to bare FR4 rear-edge stop, into original divider. Extraction-Y: bare front FR4 margins to removable panel rear face, into retainer frame and two M2 screws/inserts/floor. BendingZ: bare USB-wing margins captured between full lower ledges and upper feet; no component or pin contact. Tolerances, printing anisotropy, insert retention and real cable loads require prototype checks.

assembly_removal_steps: remove three top cover screws plus one horizontal right-side M3x8, then lift cover+Z (its M3 insert leg leaves with it)
remove two USB M2x5 and lift USB retainer+Z
disconnect harnesses, remove two PCB M2x7, then lift PCB+carrier+Z
